props.gloss_en: one washes the baby before the circumcision
one washes the baby after the circumcision
and one sprinkles on him by hand
R' Elazar ben Azarya says: one washes the baby on the third day that falls on Shabbat
as it is said: 'and it was on the third day, when they were in pain' (Gen 34:25)
a doubtful [case] -- one does not desecrate Shabbat for him
and an androginos -- one does not desecrate Shabbat for him
and R' Yehuda permits for an androginos
